courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: LIGO 重力波觀測站
related.transfer: 可遷移「應變量測與地底加低溫的設計賭注」與「低溫鏡面的吸收熱預算與功率上限」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；LIGO 重力波觀測站的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Strain measurement and the underground-plus-cryogenic bet" and "Absorption heat budget and the power ceiling of cryogenic mirrors" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of LIGO gravitational-wave observatories must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦地底低地動站址、20 K 藍寶石測試質量、低溫懸吊導熱、共振邊帶擷取干涉儀與冷凝污染管理；LIGO 重力波觀測站則以4 km Fabry–Pérot 麥克森干涉儀的應變量測：臂腔、40 kg 測試質量、四重擺、散粒雜訊與壓縮光為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on low-seismic underground siting, 20 K sapphire test masses, cryogenic suspension heat extraction, resonant-sideband-extraction optics and cryo-contamination control; LIGO gravitational-wave observatories centres on strain measurement with a 4 km Fabry–Pérot Michelson: arm cavities, 40 kg test masses, quadruple pendulums, shot noise and squeezed light, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「3 km 臂與神岡地下站址」與「4 km 臂與暗紋輸出埠」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到LIGO 重力波觀測站，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「絕對校正與雜訊預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “3 km arms and the Kamioka underground site” and “4 km arms and the dark-fringe output port”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to LIGO gravitational-wave observatories, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Absolute calibration and the noise budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: KAGRA 地底低溫重力波望遠鏡
history.text: KAGRA 計畫於 2010 年啟動，2012 年 1 月在神岡舉行動工典禮，2014 年 3 月完成坑道開挖。2016 年 3 月以室溫熔融石英鏡進行簡易麥克森運轉（iKAGRA），2018 年 4 月完成首次低溫運轉測試，2019 年完成基線設計配置。2020 年 2 月開始首次觀測並於同年 4 月與 GEO600 聯合觀測，之後參與 LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA 的第四輪觀測，在能登半島地震後修復並於 2025 年恢復觀測。
history.textEn: The KAGRA project started in 2010, held its ground-breaking ceremony at Kamioka in January 2012 and completed tunnel excavation in March 2014. In March 2016 it ran a simple room-temperature Michelson with fused-silica mirrors (iKAGRA), in April 2018 it completed its first cryogenic test operation, and in 2019 it finished installation of the baseline design. It began observing in February 2020, observed jointly with GEO600 that April, then took part in the fourth LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA observing run, recovering from the Noto Peninsula earthquake and resuming observation in 2025.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「應變量測與地底加低溫的設計賭注」到「地下低溫營運：冷凝污染、地震恢復與交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Strain measurement and the underground-plus-cryogenic bet" through "Underground cryogenic operation: cryo-contamination, earthquake recovery and handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
